No. 01 · Minecraft modFor players

SkyBlock Companion

The HUD, item prices, a profile viewer and a helper for each island, in one mod with one settings menu.

Every feature can be switched off. Anything new in an update starts off, so nothing on a player's screen changes until they turn it on. The HUD is drawn once into a texture and reused, which keeps the whole overlay cheap.

Parts of the logic are adapted from open-source mods, SkyHanni and Skyblocker among them, and credited in the project.

Java, Fabric

No. 02 · CS2 game modeFor server owners

Jailbreak

A custom Jailbreak game mode for Counter-Strike 2, with its own menus, economy and progression.

Guards and prisoners, a guard vote, 10 last-request duels and 5 special days, with arenas that admins draw in the game. Gangs with gang days, a player market, and a 50-card battle pass with daily, weekly and lifetime quests.

Everything runs from an in-game menu: agent skins in the Black Market with a 3D preview only you see, runes from 1 to 6 stars that drop when a player dies, a daily wish wheel with CS2-style crate openings, a trade yard and rankings. The Back Room has coin flip, dice duels, crash, blackjack, roulette and crate battles.

Admins get their own menu, 99 commands, and a replay that shows a player's last 120 seconds as a ghost.

Built with
C#, CounterStrikeSharp
Data
MySQL or SQLite
Source

No. 03 · Business productFor businesses

SmartAgent

Custom voice agents that answer a business's phone, in any language.

Each agent is built for what the business needs. It can take messages, book appointments and tables, pass a call on to the right person, answer questions about hours, services and prices, or handle any other task the business defines. Every call ends up in a portal the business can go through afterwards.

I built all of it on my own: the call engine, the voice agents, the connection to the phone line, the admin panel, the customer portal and the website.

No. 04 · CS2 pluginFor server owners

Parachute

Hold E while you're falling and you float down slowly. Let go and gravity is back.

Gravity goes back to normal by itself when you land, die, respawn or a new round starts, so nobody gets stuck floating. Bots are left alone.

There's no config file and nothing to set up. The few numbers it uses sit at the top of the code for anyone who wants to change them.

No. 05 · CS2 pluginFor server owners

WeaponPhysics

Guns lying on the ground react when you shoot or slash them.

Shoot near a dropped weapon and it gets knocked away, and a knife slash sends it flying. Knives, grenades, the C4 and other utility items stay where they are.

Every push has a speed cap and a short cooldown, so nothing gets launched across the map. It works on its own, and Gun Toss on the Jailbreak server is a lot more fun with it.
